articles.title: Should China aim for the lead in making AI rules for the world?
articles.summary: China's Moonshot AI has unveiled its Kimi K3 model, which rivals leading US AI technologies in power and affordability, prompting calls for Beijing to establish global AI regulations amid a growing policy divide in the United States. This breakthrough not only positions China as a potential leader in AI governance but also highlights the urgent need for international standards in an increasingly competitive technological landscape.

articles.title: US bans new Chinese robots, power inverters in latest tech crackdown
articles.summary: The Trump administration's recent ban on new Chinese robots and power inverters marks a significant escalation in tech-related national security measures, aiming to safeguard U.S. supply chains from potential vulnerabilities posed by foreign-made advanced technologies. This move not only underscores the growing geopolitical tensions but also highlights the critical importance of securing emerging technologies in an increasingly competitive global landscape.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang meets US officials as scrutiny grows over China chip access
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's meetings with US officials highlight growing concerns over the use of American chip technology in advancing China's AI capabilities, underscoring the critical intersection of national security and technological innovation in the global landscape. This development could reshape the future of international tech relations and regulatory frameworks.

articles.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
articles.summary: A groundbreaking report reveals that scientists are leveraging AI coding agents to revolutionize scientific computing, significantly speeding up software development and unlocking new discoveries in genomics and other fields, marking a pivotal shift in research methodologies. This advancement not only enhances efficiency but also opens new frontiers in scientific exploration and innovation.

articles.title: Looking back on Microsoft’s FY26: From AI experimentation to Frontier Transformation
articles.summary: Microsoft's FY26 marked a pivotal shift as businesses transitioned from merely experimenting with AI to leveraging it for tangible outcomes, fostering innovation and growth while giving rise to Frontier Firms that prioritize human ambition and integrate AI at their core. This transformation underscores the critical role of AI in driving strategic advancements across industries, setting a new standard for competitive excellence.

articles.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
articles.summary: Google AI's Gemini 3.6 introduces Managed Agents with advanced features like Flash, hooks, and triggers, revolutionizing the way developers can create responsive and dynamic applications by enabling seamless integration and automation. This breakthrough not only enhances user experience but also significantly accelerates the development process, positioning Google at the forefront of AI-driven innovation.

articles.title: Powerful Compute So Compact, It’s Clutch — Build AI Anywhere With NVIDIA Jetson
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Jetson platform revolutionizes AI deployment by delivering powerful computing capabilities in an ultra-compact form, enabling seamless integration of advanced AI solutions in diverse environments. This breakthrough not only enhances accessibility for developers but also accelerates innovation across industries, making AI more ubiquitous than ever.

articles.title: From CXMT to Zhipu: How Alibaba’s investment pays off with a growing AI and chip portfolio
articles.summary: Alibaba's strategic investment in ChangXin Memory Technologies and Zhipu AI has yielded significant returns, positioning the tech giant as a key player in the rapidly evolving AI and semiconductor landscape, with CXMT's recent listing further solidifying its status as a major industrial shareholder. This breakthrough not only enhances Alibaba's portfolio but also underscores the growing importance of domestic chip production in China's tech ecosystem.

articles.title: 5 ways AI Mode in Search helps you enjoy the real world
articles.summary: Google AI's new Search feature, AI Mode, revolutionizes how users engage with the real world by seamlessly integrating fun activities and personalized recommendations, enhancing everyday experiences and promoting a more active lifestyle. This breakthrough not only transforms search functionality but also encourages users to explore and enjoy their surroundings in innovative ways.

articles.title: 5 ways to host the ultimate dinner party with Google Search
articles.summary: Google AI has unveiled innovative ways to leverage Google Search for hosting the ultimate dinner party, transforming how users plan and execute gatherings by seamlessly integrating search capabilities with event preparation. This breakthrough not only enhances the user experience but also positions Google as a central tool in personal event planning, emphasizing the growing intersection of technology and social interaction.

articles.title: Apple Upgrade launches in the United States
articles.summary: Apple has launched its innovative Upgrade program, allowing customers in the United States to lease hardware directly from the Apple Store, revolutionizing the way consumers access and upgrade their devices while enhancing affordability and convenience in the tech market. This strategic move not only strengthens Apple's ecosystem but also positions the company to capture a larger share of the growing leasing trend in consumer electronics.

articles.title: Moonshot’s Kimi K3 triggers Silicon Valley debate over bans on Chinese open source models
articles.summary: China's Moonshot AI has ignited a significant debate in Silicon Valley by releasing its Kimi K3 model as open source, challenging existing norms and fostering competition in the AI landscape, particularly against Nvidia's dominance. This strategic move not only democratizes access to advanced AI technology but also underscores the growing importance of non-Nvidia ecosystems in shaping the future of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: China woos Slovakia with AI, robotics pitch as EU trade friction mounts
articles.summary: China is strategically positioning itself as a key partner for Slovakia in advanced technologies like AI and robotics amid escalating trade tensions with the EU, highlighting a significant shift in geopolitical alliances that could reshape economic dynamics in the region. This collaboration not only underscores Slovakia's unique stance within the EU but also signals China's intent to deepen its influence in Central and Eastern Europe.

articles.title: The light narrows
articles.summary:
• The author's journey into jiu-jitsu serves as a poignant response to the profound grief of losing a father.  
• Defeat on the mat mirrors the internal struggles of vulnerability and identity in the face of loss.  
• Low testosterone becomes a metaphor for the broader existential crises that accompany aging and mortality.  
• The temptation of a chemical "cheat code" raises ethical questions about authenticity and the human experience.  
• Ultimately, the essay explores the intersection of physicality, grief, and the search for meaning in life's inevitable challenges.

articles.title: China chip dreams still face long road even after breakthrough
articles.summary: China's advancement in mass-producing deep ultraviolet immersion lithography machines signifies a pivotal move towards technological self-sufficiency in chipmaking, yet the nation still faces significant challenges on its path to becoming a global leader in semiconductor technology. This breakthrough could reshape the competitive landscape of the chip industry, but the road ahead remains fraught with obstacles.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO urges Washington to tighten China chip export bans
articles.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is calling for stricter chip export bans to China, emphasizing that such measures are essential to maintain the US's competitive edge in artificial intelligence and prevent the potential military misuse of advanced AI technologies by Beijing. This push highlights the critical intersection of technology and national security in the evolving global landscape.
